clue.text: Steer vehicle?

parts.note: read as a lorry for carrying cattle, since a steer is a bullock and cattle are livestock; really the banger-racing car of the oval track

explanation.surface: A one-line question about driving: how to steer a vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steer' looks like a verb about driving, but it is the noun, a young bullock, i.e. farm stock.
explanation.definitionFit: A stock car is an ordinary saloon modified for rough track racing, and the clue pretends it carries livestock.

clue.text: Member of military religious order finds MP, Liberal, in hurry

indicators.note: the politician and the party letter go in the word for hurry

parts.note: to tear along is to hurry
MP, Member of Parliament, is taken as written

explanation.surface: A medieval knight discovers a Liberal politician in a rush.
explanation.definitionFit: The Knights Templar were a medieval order of crusading monks who also fought as soldiers.

clue.text: Dangerous waters south of cape, hard by rocky island

definitions.text: Dangerous waters south of cape, hard by rocky island

parts.words: Dangerous waters south of cape, hard by rocky island
parts.note: a sailing description of the legendary whirlpool in the Strait of Messina, near a Sicilian cape and opposite the monster's rock

explanation.surface: A pilot's warning about treacherous sea by a rocky island.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening letters C (cape) and H (hard) start the answer, but nothing in the clue supplies the rest as wordplay, so it is read as a descriptive definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this whirlpool opposite Scylla menaced Odysseus's ship in the strait between Sicily and Italy.

clue.text: Honda car in urban area

definitions.meaning: a long-running small family model from the Japanese carmaker
describing things in or relating to a town or city

explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese firm sells a hatchback of that name, and the adjective means municipal, belonging to a city.

clue.text: What's big, rising up in Med?

definitions.text: What's big, rising up in Med?

parts.words: What's big, rising up in Med
parts.note: a riddle about a great landmark towering over the western Mediterranean at Spain's southern tip

explanation.surface: A riddle about something huge rising from the Mediterranean.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue carries no letter count.
explanation.definitionFit: The limestone promontory at the British territory near Spain soars over the entrance to the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Make a hole in seaside feature by church

parts.note: a pier is the walkway jutting into the sea at a British resort
CE is short for Church of England

explanation.surface: Instructions to drill through a seaside structure beside a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To perforate or puncture something is to make a hole in it.

clue.text: Present bird to monarch -predatory one

parts.note: an owl is a bird
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen's monogram

explanation.surface: Someone offers a bird to the Queen, who is a predator.
explanation.definitionFit: A prowler roams about stealthily looking for prey or something to steal.

clue.text: Brought up work by English writer

indicators.note: in a down clue, bringing up means the letters read from bottom to top, reversed

parts.note: toil is hard work

explanation.surface: An English writer was raised on hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: George Eliot and T. S. Eliot are both famous authors with this surname.

clue.text: In company, played mono in which tenor features, briskly

indicators.note: played suggests the letters are performed in a new arrangement

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for tenor in music

explanation.surface: A tenor joins a mono recording, playing in company with others at a lively pace.
explanation.walkthrough: The musical term is Italian for 'with movement'. 'in which tenor features' places T among the letters of MONO before they are jumbled.
explanation.definitionFit: Con moto is an Italian tempo marking telling performers to play with movement, i.e. briskly.

clue.text: Novel American writer from the east

indicators.note: in an across clue, reading from the east means right to left, so the pieces run backwards

parts.note: the writer of a clue refers to themself as ME

explanation.surface: A new American author arriving from eastern parts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like an adjective meaning new; it is the noun, a book by Jane Austen.
explanation.definitionFit: Jane Austen's 1815 book about a meddling matchmaker is titled after its heroine.

clue.text: The winner's one with two articles of old furniture?

parts.note: the winner is the victor; the 's stands for 'has' and joins on
I is the Roman numeral for one
two indefinite articles: an and a
two indefinite articles: an and a

explanation.surface: Prize-winner collects a piece of antique furniture accompanied by grammatical articles.
explanation.definitionFit: Objects from the reign of the Queen who ruled 1837-1901, such as furniture, are collected under this name.

clue.text: Drama's attractive to youngsters, including Henry, in nursery

parts.note: plays are drama; the 's makes it plural-sounding pieces of drama

indicators.note: the word for attractive to youngsters holds the abbreviation within it

parts.note: cool is the young person's word for stylish or appealing
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Theatre that appeals to children, with someone named Henry, staged in a nursery.
explanation.definitionFit: A playschool is a pre-school group for small children, another name for a nursery school.

clue.text: Captured to right

parts.note: OK means all right, correct

explanation.surface: A terse note: seized and moved towards the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Took is the past tense of take, as in seized or captured a city.

clue.text: Woman fared badly

indicators.note: something done badly is muddled, so the letters of the neighbouring word are jumbled

explanation.surface: A woman who did poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: Freda is a woman's first name, the usual crossword 'woman' or 'girl'.

clue.text: Gas roger's misused as an attacker

indicators.note: letters used wrongly are jumbled out of their proper order

parts.note: the possessive is spelt out with its S, which counts here

explanation.surface: A man named Roger has his gas misused, making him an assailant.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who starts a fight or invasion is the aggressor, the one who attacks first.

clue.text: Sort of TV getting a mention in place

indicators.note: the article and the verb sit in the word for place

parts.note: a site is a place
to tell is to mention or relate

explanation.surface: A kind of television gets a reference somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Satellite TV is broadcast by signals relayed from an orbiting spacecraft, a type of television service.

clue.text: Die for the secret of enlightened photography

definitions.text: Die for the secret of enlightened photography

parts.words: Die for the secret of enlightened photography
parts.note: a die is a cube, and this one is the disposable four-bulb gadget that lit up old snapshots; 'enlightened' means literally lit

explanation.surface: A dramatic sentence about being willing to die to learn a photographic secret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Die' looks like a verb (to perish for a secret), but it is the noun, a cube like a dice.
explanation.definitionFit: A flashcube was a small cube of four flashbulbs that clipped onto a camera to light a picture.

clue.text: Italian community support warning device

parts.note: a leg supports a table or a body
a car's horn warns other road users

explanation.surface: An Italian town backs a warning siren.
explanation.walkthrough: This is the traditional English name for the port of Livorno; 'Italian' might suggest the chicken breed of the same name.
explanation.definitionFit: Livorno, a Tuscan port city, was long called by this anglicised name in English.

clue.text: Personal property alluded to in conversation on phone

parts.note: a chat is a conversation
TEL is the abbreviation for telephone

explanation.surface: Possessions talked about during a phone call.
explanation.definitionFit: A chattel is an item of movable personal property, as in goods and chattels.

clue.text: Cease holding male in jazz dance

indicators.note: the word for cease holds the other letter inside it

parts.note: to cease is to stop

explanation.surface: An order to stop a man from joining a jazz dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The stomp is a lively jazz dance and tune with heavy stamping beats.

clue.text: Second piece about to be penned is imitative

indicators.note: penned means enclosed, so this letter is shut inside the other pieces

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second
the king is a chess piece
C is short for circa, about

explanation.surface: A second piece of writing is about to be penned as a copy.
explanation.definitionFit: Mimicking someone in a scornful way is copying them, so the word describes jeering imitation.

clue.text: Some flag half-mast for eastern commander

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A flag lowered to half-mast in honour of an Eastern military leader.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'for', which is only a link joining the wordplay to 'eastern commander'; the defining words alone are a noun phrase that can stand in for the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An agha was an Ottoman military officer or chief, a title of command in the East.

clue.text: A piano for inspection on this?

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
pro means for, in favour of

explanation.surface: Someone asking whether a piano can be taken home for a trial.
explanation.walkthrough: Goods sent 'on appro' (on approval) may be returned after inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: Appro is short for approval, as goods sent on approval may be examined before buying.

clue.text: One set to bring about a well-timed uprising?

definitions.text: One set to bring about a well-timed uprising?

parts.words: One set to bring about a well-timed uprising
parts.note: the uprising is a sleeper getting out of bed, not a rebellion, and the device is set for a chosen hour

explanation.surface: A conspirator primed to start a revolt at the right moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uprising' suggests a revolution; it means rising from bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedside timepiece that rings at a preset hour wakes the sleeper so they get up on time.

clue.text: Tipsy writer's about to blunder

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the possessive goes outside the blunder

parts.note: the setter's own, i.e. my
to err is to blunder

explanation.surface: A tipsy author is about to make a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightly drunk people are said to be merry, cheerfully tipsy.

clue.text: One striving to get trip to come off

indicators.note: off here means gone wrong or out of order, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone trying hard to make a planned journey actually happen.
explanation.definitionFit: A rival in a contest is someone striving to win.

clue.text: Hibernian almost flag

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short of its final letter

parts.note: Hibernian means from Ireland, Hibernia being its Latin name

explanation.surface: An almost-Irish flag.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow flag is a wild species of the flower, so flag is another name for this plant.

clue.text: Get spread out to put on a French brioche?

parts.note: un is the French for a
a brioche is a sweet bread roll

explanation.surface: A question about putting a spread on a French breakfast bun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' suggests butter or jam on bread; here it means opened out flat.
explanation.definitionFit: To unroll a carpet or map is to open it out so it lies spread flat.

clue.text: Essex place where Sir Walter has yen to get in

indicators.note: the abbreviation is made to get into the explorer's surname

parts.note: Sir Walter Raleigh, the Elizabethan courtier and explorer
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A town in Essex where the famous Elizabethan explorer longs to be admitted.
explanation.walkthrough: Essex is a county east of London; Rayleigh is a town there.
explanation.definitionFit: Rayleigh is a market town in south-east Essex, England.
